documents.title: Python Documentation: History and License
documents.text: Python was created by Guido van Rossum. Python was first released in 1991. Its development began at CWI in the Netherlands.

documents.title: Python language overview
documents.text: The Python programming language was created by Guido van Rossum. It was first released in 1991 and emphasizes readability.
